_comment: EXAMPLE task/set config for one experiment family (Parts D/E). Nothing here has been run.
task_name labels the family: e0_plumbing | e1_extraction | e2_condition | e3_translation |
e4_retrieval. Reference spacings and bins are fixed BEFORE rendering (PROT-SKY-001 §3, D3) and
are not revisited once a retrieval number exists.
The three sources are written for the SAME grid, so a difference between their results can only
come from their curves; 'sets' asserts that materialisation identity.
